About Me

19. Founder.
Builder.

On April 9th, 2024 I got a call saying I'd been selected as a Harvey Scholar at the Colorado School of Mines — 1 of 12 from over 1,300 applicants, full ride. I showed up motivated.

It didn't take long before I realized I was building something bigger. I founded MediPath AI LLC, started landing real clients, and by early 2026 made the hardest decision of my life — walking away from my scholarship to go all in.

I've built systems for 75,000+ customers, shipped websites across 7+ industries, and managed an offshore dev team and U.S.-based operations manager. I'm currently studying Computer Information Systems at the University of Colorado Denver.
